An '''adamant spear''' is the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] [[spear]], made by smithing a [[Diamond Spear|diamond spear]] with [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]]. It deals 5 damage at an attack speed of 0.87 and has 5000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/adamant_spear.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade uses no template: the template slot of the [[Smithing Table|smithing table]] is left empty.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Sharpness]] I
* [[Unbreaking]] II
* {{G|Weakness}} Weakness: gives the target Weakness II for 8 to 12 seconds on every hit, which feeds adamant armor's [[Doom]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/adamant_weapon.json}}</ref>

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Adamant equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}} or [[Adamant Scrap|adamant scrap]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/netherite_ingot_from_blasting_netherite_materials.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
An apprentice-level [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] takes it in exchange for one [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/netherite_spear.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows attack damage 4 (real value 5), attack speed 0.95 (real value 0.87).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/adamant_spear.json}}</ref>
